From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — bank details + PO tagging

Hi Amy — thanks for sending these over. I’ve reviewed the ACH form and W-9. Quick answers below and a small request so our payops and ledger team can map everything cleanly:

- Remittance line: we ingest a single structured remittance value. Best practice is: PO:<PO_NUMBER> | PROJ:<PROJECT_CODE> | VENDOR_REF:<INTERNAL_REF>
- Field name we use for automated PO matching is: "order_id". If you can ensure the PO number appears in the invoice header and also in the remittance line above we’ll get an automatic match 95% of the time.
- Bank credential verification: we do a micro-deposit to verify routing/account. Once you confirm the account type (checking vs savings) and the preferred receiving bank name we’ll kick that off.

I’m attaching our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf which includes the PO tagging example. Can you confirm you can put PO and project code in the remittance field in that exact format?

Thanks — I’ll loop Jordan on the mapping and Ben will take the verification task.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attach: vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf

Amy — looping Jordan in to confirm the field mapping and to schedule the micro-deposit. Jordan, short summary / sample we need from Crestline to map:

- remittance example (single string): PO:123456 | PROJ:045678 | VENDOR_REF:CRST-2027-01
- invoice layout: PO as top-line invoice field (not only in footer)
- ACH details already provided in crestline_ach_authorization.pdf — looks in order but we need account_type confirmation (checking/savings) and an authorization signature line scanned (we have the W9 already).

Jordan — can you confirm we can map the "order_id" column to the PO number on ingest and let me know ETA for micro-deposit (I’ll inform the vendor).

Thanks,
